nativeCompilation.reason: No Delphi compiler or Android device is available. Original DPR/DPROJ/FMX files are user-owned and not in this source-only archive.

limitations: The reported game Access violation could not be reproduced on a device here; internal popup/lifetime risks were removed, but disappearance must be checked in Delphi/Android.
ComboBox closed surface follows app dark/light colors; the native Android selection dialog follows Android styling.
The server enforces account-change restrictions; only existing registered device/phone data is returned. Unknown/unregistered fields are not fabricated.
No raw biometric templates, device secrets or installation tokens are added to the new member lookup.
Photo images may be resized further for complex content to meet bounded wire sizes.
APK and Relay/WebAdmin must be updated together.
